I haven't saved the draft yet. It's waiting on June Osei-Lark's approval.

Marcus is asking to send the Brackenwater rate to Hollis Mbeki. Hollis isn't on the account, so under the finance-figures rule June (or Anselm Grieve) has to approve first. No external-mail approval is needed, because hmbeki@pemberline.com is internal.

What I did:
- Logged the approval request with June as the approver, pointing at Marcus's thread in #north-random.
- Replied in that thread. I told Marcus the draft is ready but not saved yet: to hmbeki@pemberline.com, subject "Brackenwater 2027 rate", giving the proposed 2027 rate of $1,931 per seat for the Saltire pricing review. In the same reply I asked June for her OK. Marcus had already posted the rate in that thread, so repeating it there was allowed.

Once June approves, I'll save the draft in Marcus's mailbox and he'll send it himself.
